about:
Northern Hydraulics Inc. has operated from Black Eagle, Montana, on the northern edge of Great Falls, since 1963. Founded as a hydraulic supply house, the company serves the region’s farms, fleets, and industrial operations with a focus on hydraulic components and equipment.

The company stocks over 15,700 hydraulic parts from more than 60 manufacturers, including Stanley, Enerpac, Bucher/Monarch, Parker, Williams, Char-Lynn, and others. Its catalog covers pumps, cylinders, motors, valves, power units, fittings, quick couplers, and log-splitter components. Beyond distribution, Northern Hydraulics offers custom build orders, repair services, and a dedicated sourcing desk that tracks down obsolete or hard-to-find parts, typically responding the same day. Orders for stocked items ship the same day, and qualifying orders receive free shipping.

Customers range from agricultural producers and fleet maintenance shops to industrial facilities across the United States. The company’s walk-in counter in Black Eagle serves local buyers, while its online catalog and phone support handle nationwide orders. Business accounts can use purchase-order checkout, apply for credit terms, and submit parts lists for consolidated quotes with volume discounts and cross-references for discontinued items.

Northern Hydraulics differentiates itself through its sourcing desk for obsolete parts, same-day dispatch on stock orders, and a combination of online, phone, and walk-in access backed by a 60-plus-brand inventory.
